jobs.description: POSITION SUMMARY: The Fleet Maintenance Supervisor is responsible for supervising a maintenance shop that is under the umbrella responsibility of a Maintenance Manager. The Fleet Maintenance Supervisor’s responsibilities include supervising a technician (mechanic) team responsible for preventive maintenance/repair of a fleet; machinery that supports a post-collection facility; repair/maintenance of equipment that services the container shop; and providing direction to technicians to ensure that all repairs/maintenance to equipment (trucks -- diesel and alternate fuel, containers and other heavy duty equipment) are performed in compliance with Company safety and compliance standards, and with all federal and state regulations. The Fleet Maintenance Supervisor is responsible for planning and scheduling repair work for the work group to ensure that all work is done in a safe and timely manner, reducing lost productivity. PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES: Provide direction to A, B and C level, and lead technicians assigned to work group to ensure that all repair and maintenance work is performed in a safe, efficient and timely manner. Monitor operational performance and efficiency and take action to redirect activities appropriately. Report to management on performance; make recommendations for process/programmatic changes for improvement or efficiencies. Supervise technicians in maintenance shop, including such responsibilities as conducting daily shop huddles; fleet walks; coaching/counseling/ training lead technician and all technician levels on performance/corrective action, when necessary; make hiring/termination decisions in concert with Human Resources and appropriate management; conduct employee training and performance evaluations; evaluate and make recommendations for merit increase, promotion and job changes, as appropriate. Perform inspections of outside repairs to ensure all work was properly completed in accordance with Company’s safety and compliance procedures and federal and state regulations; follow up where appropriate. Identify training opportunities and, as necessary, document issues and constructively discuss corrective action, as needed, with technician. Conduct Quality Control Inspections, track issues and resolution to ensure all work is properly completed in accordance with Company’s safety and compliance procedures and federal and state regulations. Oversee repair diagnostics on more complex matters and provide coaching, where necessary; may be required to road test vehicles to determine necessary repairs. Oversee maintenance shop inventory control system to ensure necessary equipment and parts levels are maintained and purchases are within budget. Review and approve expenses that are within scope of approval level; refer larger expenses or major repairs to manager as appropriate. Maintain advanced knowledge of engine, emission systems, transmission, brake, hydraulic and electrical systems to perform advanced preventive and repair maintenance functions on heavy equipment and vehicles used by Company, on site and on the road, including: engine chassis repair and maintenance; knowledge of vehicle body control systems, including hydraulics and electrical systems to maintain and repair vehicles in a timely and safe manner; knowledge of heating and air conditioning systems to effectively diagnose and repair complex heating and cooling systems in vehicles in a timely and safe manner; and knowledge of welding tools to fix heavy equipment in a safe and efficient manner to ensure equipment is back in an operable condition as quickly and as safely as possible. Manage related administrative matters for team, including payroll, maintenance of employee records, records of all preventive and corrective maintenance performed, recording of all information into Dossier Maintenance Software, prepare and submit budget for approval, set departmental goals to align with targets and performance objectives established by division’s leadership. QUALIFICATIONS: High school diploma or G.E.D. Automotive Service Excellence (ASE) Certification T3 Drive. T4 Brake. T5 Suspension and Steering. T6 Electrical/Electronic. T7 HVAC Systems. ASE T2 Diesel Engine. ASE T Master Certified. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS: 3 years of experience in maintenance working with heavy equipment. 1 year of supervisory experience in a lead technician role, supervisor or other management role requiring a thorough knowledge of safe working practices, DOT, OSHA and other federal and state regulations. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer. Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment. Driven : We deliver results in the right way. Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person. We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers. Recycling and Waste We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs. Environmental Solutions Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

• The work we do and the innovation we drive
• Our values of share, care and dare
• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a Commerce Product Strategist, you are passionate about transforming complex customer experiences into unified, scalable digital commerce ecosystems. You bring 8+ years of experience in digital strategy, customer experience, commerce, consulting, or transformation programs, with a proven ability to align business objectives, customer needs, and technology capabilities.

You thrive in ambiguity, quickly synthesize complex inputs, and help organizations define a clear path toward a modern commerce vision.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

• A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
• A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
• Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
• Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role Responsibilities

Lead Commerce Vision & Strategic Alignment

• Partner with client executives and senior stakeholders to define a unified commerce strategy aligned to business objectives and growth ambitions.

• Facilitate alignment across business units, product teams, sales organizations, marketing teams, and digital leaders.

• Help organizations navigate transformation initiatives stemming from acquisitions, mergers, or business expansion.
• Translate strategic business goals into actionable commerce experience roadmaps.

Drive Product Strategy & Backlog Definition

• Partner with client stakeholders to define product vision, strategic priorities, and business outcomes.
• Translate business goals, user needs, and market opportunities into structured product requirements.
• Create, manage, and maintain prioritized product backlogs that guide delivery teams.
• Define epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
• Balance strategic thinking with execution planning to ensure teams are working on the highest-value initiatives.
• Facilitate prioritization discussions and roadmap planning sessions with client stakeholders.

Define Future-State Customer & Commerce Experiences

• Analyze and unify complex customer journeys across multiple audiences, business units, and digital touchpoints.

• Develop persona frameworks that align customer needs with business priorities.

• Identify friction points, experience gaps, and opportunities within the commerce ecosystem.

• Define future-state commerce experiences that deliver customer value while supporting organizational goals.

Turn Research Into Strategic Direction

• Synthesize qualitative and quantitative research, stakeholder interviews, customer insights, market dynamics, and business objectives.

• Understand competitive landscapes and commerce trends to inform strategic recommendations.

• Translate complex information into clear frameworks, narratives, and decision-making tools.

• Deliver actionable recommendations that guide experience design, platform implementation, and organizational change.

Connect Business Strategy, Experience, and Technology

• Collaborate closely with experience, design, technology, architecture, product, and delivery teams.

• Ensure commerce strategies are feasible, scalable, and aligned with platform capabilities, including Adobe Commerce.

• Partner with implementation teams to maintain strategic alignment throughout discovery and delivery phases.

• Help clients understand how customer experience, business processes, and technology decisions work together to drive growth.

Lead Executive Conversations

• Present strategic recommendations and future-state visions to senior executives.

• Build consensus among diverse stakeholders with competing priorities.

• Act as a trusted advisor throughout transformation initiatives.

Must Have Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in digital strategy, customer experience strategy, commerce strategy, management consulting, product strategy, or related fields.

• Experience leading strategic discovery and transformation initiatives for enterprise organizations.

• Strong understanding of customer journey mapping, service design, experience strategy, and persona development.

• Proven ability to facilitate executive workshops and stakeholder alignment sessions.

• Experience translating business strategy into digital experience and commerce recommendations.

• Strong analytical, research, storytelling, and presentation skills.

• Ability to simplify complex organizational challenges into actionable plans.

• Strong product management and backlog management experience.

• Experience defining and prioritizing epics, features, user stories, and product roadmaps.

• Experience leading discovery workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and stakeholder interviews.

• Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured product requirements.

• Experience working in Agile environments alongside product, design, engineering, and delivery teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Adobe Commerce, Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Commerce, Shopify Enterprise, or similar commerce platforms.

• Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, or large-scale business transformation initiatives.

• B2B commerce experience.

• Familiarity with digital transformation programs and customer experience modernization efforts.

• Consulting or agency background preferred.

The benefits

This is a Full time position based in Canada. The offered salary range is $100,000 - $160,000 CAD annually, depending on experience and location.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

• Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
• Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
• Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts
• Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, plus employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

TEAM OVERVIEW

The Global Security & Operational Resilience team provides 24/7 support across the Firm’s global operations, helping protect people, assets, and the continuity of critical business services. The ~80-member global team drives readiness through integrated physical security and investigations, threat and intelligence monitoring, crisis management, and enterprise operational resilience planning, exercising, and response.

POSITION SUMMARY

KKR is seeking a principal-level Head of Operational Resilience to lead the design, implementation, and execution of the firm’s global Operational Resilience program. Reporting to the Head of Security and Operational Resilience, this role is responsible for driving accountability and adherence to impact tolerance and recovery objectives during severe and plausible disruption by embedding requirements into day-to-day operations, operating effective controls, and leading remediation efforts to closure.

This role partners closely with Technology, Business leadership, Enterprise Risk Management, Compliance, Vendor management, Human Capital, and Internal Audit to maintain alignment with client, investor, and regulatory expectations and enterprise risk standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Key responsibilities include:

• Leadership & Operating Model
• Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing operational resilience team.
• Influence cross-functional stakeholders to deliver enterprise resilience outcomes and measurable program maturity.
• Program Ownership & Roadmap
• Own and operate KKR’s Operational Resilience program and multi-year roadmap, including associated procedures, playbooks, and evidence management.
• Establish and maintain governance routines to track progress, escalate risks, and drive timely decision-making.
• Important Business Services & Impact Tolerances
• Identify, maintain, and periodically review the inventory of Important Business Services (IBS) and support dependencies across people, processes, technology, data, facilities, and third parties.
• Define, document, and operationalize IBS impact tolerances with business leaders; ensure tolerances are measurable, actionable, and embedded in operating procedures and controls.
• Scenario Testing & Exercising
• Design and execute severe but plausible scenario testing and resilience exercises to validate the ability to remain within impact tolerances and recovery time objectives.
• Document outcomes, lessons learned, and resulting control enhancements; ensure improvements are implemented and sustained.
• Business Continuity Management
• Own and oversee the Business Continuity Management (BCM) program, including plan development, certification, governance, training/awareness, testing/exercises, and event execution.
• Control Effectiveness & Remediation
• Identify resilience gaps and drive remediation to closure with clear accountability, milestones, and risk transparency.
• Track remediation progress through governance forums and management reporting.
• Integrated Response & Recovery
• Coordinate resilience integration across crisis management, cyber incident response, technology disaster recovery, and physical security response to enable a unified enterprise response and recovery capability.
• Metrics, Reporting & Communication
• Establish and maintain resilience KPIs/KRIs, dashboards, and management reporting to communicate posture, key risks, and remediation status to senior leadership.
• Lead preparedness, communications, and awareness initiatives to strengthen resilience culture and improve adoption of planning and control requirements across global functions.
• Audit, Risk, and Regulatory Support
• Support regulatory reviews, risk assessments, and internal/external audits by providing timely documentation, evidence, and program narratives.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 10+ years of experience in operational resilience, business continuity, enterprise risk, or related disciplines; experience in financial services or similarly regulated environments preferred.
• Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-level resilience initiatives and driving cross-functional delivery in a global organization.
• Strong understanding of global regulatory expectations and industry standards (e.g., Basel, ISO 22301, NIST, PRA/FCA or comparable).
• Experience engaging with senior leadership during disruption events and managing complex stakeholder environments.
• Sector knowledge/experience in Insurance, Asset Management, Capital Markets, and Structuring processes.

CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS

• Executive presence with the ability to communicate resilience posture, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to senior leaders.
• Strong stakeholder management and influence across Technology, business functions, and control partners (ERM, Compliance, Audit).
• Program and change leadership: ability to build roadmaps, drive adoption, and deliver measurable outcomes across a global organization.
• Analytical rigor and diligence; ability to translate complex dependencies into practical controls and recovery strategies.
• Decisive leadership under pressure, including crisis response coordination and effective prioritization during disruption events.
• Strong writing and documentation capability; comfortable producing defensible evidence for audits and regulatory reviews.
• Continuous improvement orientation, including process enhancement, tooling modernization, and operational discipline.

Jij bent werkzaam binnen het dagdienst team (07.00 tot 15.30) waar machinale en handmatige inpakwerkzaamheden worden uitgevoerd. About Whirlpool Corporation

Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) is a leading home appliance company, in constant pursuit of improving life at home. As the only major U.S.-based manufacturer of kitchen and laundry appliances, the company is driving meaningful innovation to meet the evolving needs of consumers through its iconic brand portfolio, including Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul, and InSinkErator. In 2025, the company reportedapproximately $16 billion in annual net sales - close to 90% of which were in the Americas - 41,000 employees, and 35 manufacturing and technology research centers. Additional information about the company can be found at WhirlpoolCorp.com.

## This role in summary

The KASA US Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) team serves as the primary e-commerce engine and cross-functional hub for KitchenAid small appliances, owning the end-to-end consumer journey across KitchenAid.com and leading digital marketplace partners. Beyond driving rapid top-line growth, KASA D2C operates as the company's strategic innovation catalyst and financial anchor—spearheading global initiatives in AI-driven shopping, modern MarTech, and predictive customer journeys. Joining this team puts you at the center of digital transformation, where your work directly shapes the future of an iconic premium consumer brand.

## Your responsibilities will include

In this role, you deliver complete P&L performance—driving top-line revenue growth and bottom-line profit expansion. You own our monthly, quarterly, and yearly sales outlooks, ensuring our commercial strategy delivers on those targets while closing any gaps to profit plan. You are responsible for defining the commercial roadmap, steering demand generation and capture strategies, optimizing D2C cost structures, and bringing unique site value propositions to life that differentiate our brand channel from retail partners. Success in this role requires a willingness to challenge the status quo, find bold new ways to differentiate our direct channel, and apply the operational rigor needed to transform how we work. This includes driving efficiency, leveraging AI and automation, and streamlining go-to-market (GTM) operations. You will influence through strong collaboration and thought leadership across matrixed organizational teams, working closely with a Sr. Analyst, Project Manager, and key partners like Business Intelligence, Operations, CRM and Performance Media to unlock data-driven opportunities and scale the business efficiently.

* Sales & Profit Forecasting: Manage and deliver comprehensive Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) sales outlooks, profit plans, and agile commercial strategies to achieve volume and margin targets.
* Margin Optimization: Protect net profitability by actively managing D2C cost drivers, including fulfillment, warehousing, marketplace commissions, and media investments.
* Brand Differentiation: Develop innovative value propositions to clearly differentiate the brand's direct website (KitchenAid.com) from external retail partners.
* Operational Automation: Streamline Go-To-Market (GTM) operations and transform legacy workflows by integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automated tools.
* Data-Driven Loyalty: Partner with Business Intelligence (BI) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) to uncover insights, shift demand to lower-cost owned channels, and build a robust First-Party (1P) customer database.
* Executive Alignment: Influence regional and global leadership teams to secure support and buy-in for new strategic growth initiatives.
* Agile Testing: Implement a continuous test-and-learn methodology to rapidly test novel commercial offers, run sprint planning, and measure financial impact.
* Team Mentorship & Execution: Mentor cross-functional teams and oversee execution partners to ensure the seamless delivery of promotional calendars, site enhancements, and forecasting entries.

## Minimum requirements

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 6+ years of experience in Ecommerce, D2C Strategy, Commercial Sales Management, and/or P&L Ownership.
* Proven track record delivering on an end-to-end P&L, including product mix, spend, supply/fulfillment costs, and marketing ROI.

## Preferred skills and experiences

* MBA or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, or Marketing.
* 8+ years of progressive commercial leadership in consumer packaged goods (CPG), consumer durables, or direct-to-consumer ecommerce.
* Demonstrated experience delivering on sales outlooks using gap-closure strategies, while leveraging Business Intelligence, AI, and automation frameworks to optimize operations.
* Strong influence and thought leadership skills, with a history of driving cross-functional alignment across media, CRM, operations, BI, and global leadership teams.
* Experience establishing brand-differentiating online value propositions (e.g., custom bundles, exclusive assortments, loyalty perks).
* Passion for talent development, mentoring, and building strong organizational capability.

## What we offer

Generous benefits package, Whirlpool employee discount, fitness & educational reimbursement programs, kitchenettes, and more! Saint Joseph/Benton Harbor locations: Beautiful, recently renovated office space, Barista Bar, biking/walking trails, and access to The Eddy - Early Childhood Center (depending upon availability - additional costs required).

## Additional information

Whirlpool’s Ways of Working

Our goal is to provide an environment that helps you bring your best to Whirlpool every day. While employees in this role work in-person Monday through Friday. We offer flexibility and industry-leading time-off benefits that will help you balance what’s important at work and at home, including:

* Always On Flexibility \- You will have the autonomy to manage personal, family, and outside-of-work commitments as needed.

* Two-Week Work from Anywhere \- Minimum of one-week increments for a total of two weeks per year.

* Sabbatical \- Four weeks paid leave after every five years of service.

Connect with us and learn more about Whirlpool Corporation

See what it's like to work at Whirlpool by visiting Whirlpool Careers. Additional information about the company can be found on Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
